valuation.vl3_basis: trailing P/E, 5 years (price / last-12-month SEC diluted EPS), labelled

dm4.name: Organic revenue growth
dm4.what: Coca-Cola's own growth measure: revenue growth vs the same quarter last year, excluding currency moves and bottlers bought or sold.
dm4.why: It is the number management guides on (2026: about +5%) and the market trades on; unlike reported revenue it is not distorted by the sale of bottlers such as CCBA.
dm4.bull_means: At or above the top (+6%) of Coca-Cola's long-run 4-6% target range.
dm4.neutral_means: Between +4% and +6%: inside the target range.
dm4.bear_means: At or below the bottom (+4%) of the target range.

dm4.name: Unit case volume growth
dm4.what: How many more drinks the whole Coca-Cola system sold to consumers vs the same quarter last year.
dm4.why: Shows whether growth comes from people buying more, not just from higher prices. Price-only growth is the warning sign for a consumer brand.
dm4.bull_means: Consumers are buying clearly more cases.
dm4.bear_means: Volume is flat or falling: growth is price-led.

dm5.name: Coca-Cola bottlers' volume growth (CCEP, Coca-Cola HBC, Coca-Cola FEMSA)
dm5.source: Bottlers' quarterly results and trading updates (average of the three)
dm5.latest: +4.2% (Apr-Jun 2026: CCEP +3.2% days-adjusted, Coca-Cola HBC +5.8% underlying, Coca-Cola FEMSA +3.5%)
dm5.what: Average volume growth reported by the three largest listed Coca-Cola bottlers vs the same quarter last year.
dm5.why: An outside check on demand for Coca-Cola drinks across Europe, Africa, Asia-Pacific and Latin America, reported by the companies that make and deliver them.
dm5.bull_means: Bottlers are selling clearly more Coca-Cola drinks.
dm5.neutral_means: Bottler volumes are roughly flat to modestly up.

removed_indicators.reason: Coca-Cola gives full-year guidance only, never a number for next quarter, so DM3 would be blank every quarter (Kenneth, 5 Oct 2026).

chains.what_changes: overseas sales and profit translate into fewer dollars
chains.business_hit: reported revenue and EPS; 2026 EPS guidance assumes about a 3-point currency tailwind
KO's bond-like valuation (about 25x forward earnings) is harder to justify

chains.trigger: Oil and aluminium costs up (Iran war; 50% US aluminium tariff)
chains.what_changes: bottles, cans, sweeteners and transport cost more
chains.business_hit: bottlers' margins squeezed, less room for concentrate price rises; higher shelf prices
chains.company_levers: pack-size and price ladders, hedging, recycled content

chains.trigger: Health rules on sugary drinks (SNAP soda bans, sugar taxes, GLP-1 drugs)
chains.what_changes: fewer full-sugar drinks bought by affected groups

watch.name: news scan only
watch.active_if: any new state waiver, national tax or GLP-1 evidence of lower drink spend

mix._note: Revenue mix (not scored). Coca-Cola's filings print every segment's row as 'operating revenues', so the engine splits the shared label by member tag; patterns match member words. Asia Pacific is left in Other: its tag changed between filings (Pacific / A.Pacific), so its fourth quarter 2025 cannot be derived (open item for the Framework chat).
mix.note: Coca-Cola reports operating profit for each operating segment. Other = Asia Pacific, Global Ventures (Costa, to 2024), corporate and the removal of sales between segments (mainly concentrate sold to Coca-Cola's own bottlers).
